title: (RHBA-2014:1699) devtoolset-2-eclipse bug fix update
portal_summary:
Updated devtoolset-2-eclipse packages that fix one bug are now available for Red
Hat Developer Toolset 2.1.

portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure all previously released errata
relevant to your system have been applied.

This update is available via the Red Hat Network. Details on how to
use the Red Hat Network to apply this update are available at
https://access.redhat.com/articles/11258
portal_description:
The Eclipse platform is designed for building integrated development
environments (IDEs), server-side applications, desktop applications, and
everything in between. The devtoolset-2-eclipse packages provide the Red Hat
Developer Toolset version of Eclipse.

This update fixes the following bug:

* In Red Hat Enterprise Linux 6.6, the gtk2 packages have been upgraded to
version 2.24 but the cairo packages have not been updated in this release.
Previously, Eclipse conditionally used certain Cairo features based on the
version of GTK+ without checking the version of Cairo. As a consequence, Eclipse
was unable to display a window and terminated unexpectedly with an assertion
failure if the required feature of Cairo was unavailable. With this update,
Eclipse checks the version of Cairo and enables or disables its features
accordingly. As a result, Eclipse is now able to run and display graphics
correctly on Red Hat Enterprise Linux 6.6. (BZ#1132505)

Users of devtoolset-2-eclipse are advised to upgrade to these updated packages,
which fix this bug.
